done_when: When GitHub answers that the repo's plan doesn't offer branch protection (for example 'Upgrade to GitHub Pro or make this repository public'), forge init and a migration's close print one plain line saying protection was skipped because the plan doesn't offer it and that Forge's own close and merge still wait for the checks, then carry on; forge doctor says the same instead of comparing checks. Every other protection failure still refuses as today. Command-level tests with a fake gh cover the plan answer on init, on a migration's close and in doctor, and that another error still refuses.
why: forge init and a migration's close stop with an error when GitHub doesn't offer branch protection for the repo, as on free plans with private repositories, so setup can't finish there
